description: Source code for a command-line tool handling protocol communication, including reading commands, versions, and push options, with various configurable options and verbose output.

classes.name: command
classes.description: Represents a command with old and new object IDs, reference name, and status flags.

methods.name: proc_receive_verison
methods.description: Handles version negotiation and feature request parsing from the protocol.

methods.name: proc_receive_read_commands
methods.description: Reads and parses command lines from the protocol input.

methods.name: proc_receive_read_push_options
methods.description: Reads push options from the protocol input.
